name: Healing (Instant Health)
effect: Instantly heals 4 Hearts (Level I) or 8 Hearts (Level II). Harms undead mobs!

name: Regeneration
effect: Restores health over 45s (0.9 hearts every 2.5 seconds).

name: Strength
effect: Increases melee damage by +3 (Level I) or +6 (Level II).

name: Fire Resistance
effect: Complete immunity to fire, lava, and blaze fireballs for 3:00.

name: Swiftness (Speed)
effect: Increases walking speed by +20% (Level I) or +40% (Level II).

name: Night Vision
effect: Full brightness in darkness and clear vision underwater for 3:00.

name: Invisibility
effect: Renders the player model invisible for 3:00 (armor and held items remain visible).

name: Water Breathing
effect: Oxygen bar does not deplete while submerged underwater for 3:00.

name: Slow Falling
effect: Player glides gently downwards and is completely immune to fall damage for 1:30.
